extracted.name: Hot Honey Recipe
extracted.description: Our easy homemade Hot Honey recipe takes 5 minutes to make and immediately elevates anything it touches. Plus, it's cheaper than store-bought.
ingredient_lines: 1 Tablespoon Hot sauce ((vinegar based, like Franks Original, or Tapatio))
¼ teaspoon cayenne pepper (, or more, to taste)
instruction_lines: Add honey to a microwave safe bowl and warm for 30-45 seconds.
Stir in hot sauce, garlic and cayenne pepper.
Allow to cool, then store in a container with a lid, at room temperature, for up to 3 weeks.
categories: How to make spicy hot honey sauce
